d: Watch as Firstpost covers a thrilling high-seas operation conducted by the Indian Navy, bringing a tense 48-hour pirate drama to a decisive end off the northeastern coast of Somalia. After twelve armed Somali pirates hijacked the Iranian fishing vessel Azini—threatening to transform it into a mothership for launching further attacks across the Gulf of Aden—New Delhi deployed the guided-missile destroyer INS Kolkata alongside air surveillance and elite Marine Commandos. Executing a precision air-drop to regain control of the vessel, Indian naval forces overpowered the pirates and…
